title: End a stale ledger run from the run pane

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Parity row 7.4 and gap 10 (docs/orchestrator-parity.md in the s165 worktree). A relay started elsewhere, or by an orchestrator that died, stays in the slicer ledger. With no event for 30 minutes slicer calls it stale (`slicer/src/slicer/relayrun.py:64`, `:719-725`; a run that waits on the owner is never stale). The Overview shows it dim under Running with `!!` (`docs/dashboard.md:495-498`). Its pane is read-only (`internal/tui/keys.go:515-519`, `internal/tui/pane.go:328`), so ork cannot end it and the owner goes to the outer session for `slicer relay-run end`.

Slicer already provides the write: `slicer relay-run end RUN --outcome pass|fail|stopped [--close-steps done|fail]` (checked with `slicer relay-run end --help`). ork calls it through `RelayEnd` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:157-166`) and does not reimplement it. `slicer find` shows nothing that ends stale runs in bulk.

Owner decision 2026-10-29 (orchestrator-parity.md, Owner decisions): every gap is a v1.0 slice. The analysis rates it a small recovery gap (prioritized table, row 10).

Design (*proposed*): in the pane of a ledger run whose state is `stale`, `x` asks `[y/N]` and ends the run with outcome `stopped` and `--close-steps fail` (its running steps did not finish). The daemon method is `run.end-ledger` (*proposed*). It re-reads the ledger and refuses unless the run is still stale, so a heartbeat that arrives after the owner opened the pane wins. It refuses a ledger run that an unfinished ork engine run owns (the owner stops that run with `x` on its own pane). An active, waiting or ended ledger run keeps the read-only pane.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestRunEndLedgerEndsAStaleRun (daemon): with `relay-run list` returning the run as stale, `run.end-ledger` runs `relay-run end RUN --outcome stopped --close-steps fail --json --root PROJECT` once and returns the run id.
- TestRunEndLedgerRefusesAnActiveRun (daemon): a run that is no longer stale gets code `refused` and no `relay-run end` call.
- TestRunEndLedgerRefusesAnEndedRun (daemon): same for state `ended`.
- TestRunEndLedgerRefusesTheLedgerRunOfAnUnfinishedEngineRun (daemon): a stored run in state `implement` with `relay_run` equal to the id is refused; the same record in state `stopped` is allowed.
- TestRunEndLedgerUnknownRunIsNotFound (daemon): code `not_found` for an id the ledger does not list, and for an unregistered project.
- TestRunEndLedgerReturnsSlicersFailure (daemon): a failing `relay-run end` comes back as an error; nothing else is called.
- TestLedgerPaneOffersEndOnlyForAStaleRun (tui): the hint shows `x end run` on a stale ledger pane and keeps `started elsewhere, read-only` with no `x` on an active one; `x` on the active pane does nothing.
- TestLedgerPaneEndAsksFirst (tui): `x` shows the `slicer relay-run end ... --outcome stopped --close-steps fail` prompt with `[y/N] (Enter is No)`; `n`, Enter and `esc` cancel with no call.
- TestLedgerPaneEndCallsTheDaemonOnce (tui): `y` calls `EndLedger(project, run)` once; a second `x` while it runs says it is pending.
- TestLedgerPaneEndStatusAndRefresh (tui): success sets `ended ledger run RUN` and refreshes the project; a `refused` error shows its text alone.
- TestDaemonEndLedgerWire (tui): the connection sends `run.end-ledger` with `{project, run}` and maps a `refused` error through `actionError`.
- TestLedgerPaneStaleGoldens (tui): golden of the stale pane with the prompt, at 80x24, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). Run no code before the tests in steps 1-2 fail for the right reason.
1. Add the daemon tests in `internal/daemon/ledger_test.go` using `runDaemon` routes for `relay-run list` and `relay-run end` (`internal/daemon/runs_test.go:51-68` already routes `relay-run end`).
2. Add the TUI tests in `internal/tui/ledgerend_test.go` with `followLedger` and the pane harness of `internal/tui/follow_test.go:21,100`.
3. `internal/daemon/runs.go`: add `MethodRunEndLedger = "run.end-ledger"` (*proposed*) and `Project string json:"project,omitempty"` on `RunAction`. Route it in `handleRun` before `ownerRun`, and add it to the case list at `handlers.go:113`.
4. `internal/daemon/runs.go`: new `endLedger(ctx, RunAction)`. Take `d.registered(p.Project)` (`internal/daemon/reads.go:77`). Read `Slicer.RelayRuns(ctx, proj.Path, false)` and find the run: none is `not_found`; any state but `stale` is `refused`. Under `d.runs.mu` list `Store.List()`: a record with `RelayRun == p.Run` and not `runrec.IsFinal` is `refused`, naming the engine run. Then call `Slicer.RelayEnd(ctx, runrec.Writer{}, proj.Path, p.Run, "stopped", "fail")`. A nil Sink is the existing pattern for a write with no run record (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:373`). Return `{run}`.
5. `internal/daemon/client.go`: `EndLedger(ctx, project, run)` beside `Stop` (:179).
6. `internal/tui/live.go` and `daemon.go`: a small optional interface `ledgerEnder` (like `approver`, `card.go:612`) so test doubles need no change; `Daemon.EndLedger` connects and calls the client.
7. New `internal/tui/ledgerend.go`: `paneLedgerStale()` (`m.pane.ledger` and `m.paneBoardRun().State == "stale"`, `relayboard.go:154`), `requestLedgerEnd()` that sets `m.confirm` to a `runAction{verb: "end", run: ledgerID, project: name}`.
8. `pane.go:326-337`: before the `m.pane.ledger` return, send `keys.Stop` on a stale ledger pane to `requestLedgerEnd`. Reuse the `x` binding with its own label; add no key.
9. `keys.go:515-519`: on a stale ledger pane offer `short(k.Stop, "x", "end run")` ahead of the read-only note; an active pane is unchanged.
10. `model.go`: `callAction` runs `ledgerEnder.EndLedger` for verb `end`. The `actionMsg` case (`:360-380`) matches the pane by `r.engineID`, which is empty for a ledger row: match `r.ledgerID` for verb `end`, set the status, and call `m.fetch(project, true)` as `applyLaunch` does. `command()` returns `slicer relay-run end RUN --outcome stopped --close-steps fail`; `card.go:591,632` get `ended ledger run RUN` and its pending text; `confirmWord` gets `end`.
11. Docs: `dashboard.md:530` and the pane paragraph near `:729-731` say a stale ledger pane ends with `x`; `design.md:1102` documents `run.end-ledger`; `CHANGELOG.md`. Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`, review the diff in `testdata/golden/`.
Open: (1) A `ork end RUN` shell command (default: none; the pane is the surface, as the gap says). (2) Ending a stale ledger run that an already stopped engine run still links to, from the engine run's pane (default: no).
